help_intro: A short guide to finding your voice, preparing your part, and sharing your recording.
help_section_1_text: Listen to the samples of each voice and choose the one that feels most comfortable. If you're unsure between two options, start with the one you can sing without straining and consult the director.
help_section_5_title: How do I record and send it?
help_section_5_text: Find a quiet room and place the phone at a fixed distance. Do a short test, check that the voice is clear, and record the full take without moving the device. Then listen to the file, give it a clear name like `voz2_ficha3_nombre.m4a`, and share it through the channel indicated by the team.
pr_sub: Simple guide so each singer records their performance and sends it for the final production.
pr_step1_li1: Find a quiet place with little reverberation.
pr_step1_li2: Use headphones to listen to the guide without recording it.
pr_step1_li3: Place the microphone at a comfortable distance (15–20 cm).
pr_step2_p: Open your voice's sheet and play the guitar track and the guide. Get familiar with the tempo and the entry.
pr_step3_li1: Record in a single take if possible; otherwise make several and choose the best.
pr_step3_li2: Keep a steady volume and avoid overloading the microphone.
pr_step3_li3: Also record a video of you singing your part (a phone is fine).
pr_step3_li4: Don't worry about small mistakes: they can be fixed in editing.
pr_step4_p1: Save the file with a clear name:
pr_step4_p2: and send it to the director.
pr_tip_text: if you record with your phone, disable battery saving and don't close the app during recording.

voice_1_text: A clear line to start the journey.
